guideline.quote: TDF should be interrupted even if it is not thought to be the cause of the AKI.

Most cases of acute kidney injury (AKI) are not due to TDF, and if another cause of AKI is identified (e.g. severe diarrhoea or pneumonia), then TDF can be re-introduced with monitoring once renal function improves.
